title: Fisher information and the geometry of memorization in neural networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.16161v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A fruitful approach towards understanding generalization in machine learning involves characterizing how models separate generalizable structure from idiosyncratic or even corrupted features of training data. Fisher information has emerged as a diagnostic tool for this separation, leveraging loss geometry to distinguish generalization from memorization. Here we investigate this connection in vision models trained on CIFAR-10 with controlled noise that can be learned only through memorization. We show that projecting model weights onto the top Fisher eigenvectors decouples general task performance from noisy sample memorization, and we investigate how this decoupling presents differentially across layers. We show that the same phenomena are present in small transformers trained to solve a synthetic in-context learning task, and are reproduced in closed form in a simple, analytically solvable linear model. translated_title: 费舍尔信息与神经网络中记忆化的几何学
translated_abstract: 理解机器学习中泛化的一个富有成效的方法是刻画模型如何将可泛化的结构从训练数据中特异的甚至被损坏的特征中分离出来。费舍尔信息已成为实现这种分离的诊断工具，它利用损失几何来区分泛化与记忆化。在此，我们研究了在带有受控噪声的CIFAR-10数据集上训练的视觉模型，这些噪声只能通过记忆化才能被学习。我们表明，将模型权重投影到前几个费舍尔特征向量上，可以将通用任务性能与噪声样本的记忆化解耦，并且我们研究了这种解耦在不同层之间如何呈现差异。我们进一步表明，同样的现象出现在训练解决合成上下文学习任务的小型transformer模型中，并且在一个简单的、可解析求解的线性模型中以闭式形式得到复现。我们的结果揭示了费舍尔……
tldr: 该论文发现将神经网络权重投影到费舍尔信息的前几个特征向量上可以解耦模型的泛化能力与对噪声样本的记忆化，且这种解耦在不同层间表现不同，并在transformer模型和可解析求解的线性模型中得到验证。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that projecting neural network weights onto the top Fisher information eigenvectors decouples general task performance from memorization of noisy samples, with this decoupling varying across layers and being validated in both transformers and an analytically solvable linear model.
